prompt: If Anastasia Romanov had still been alive when the 90s cartoon movie based on her was released, how old would she be?
answer: If Grand Duchess Anastasia Nikolaevna had survived until the release of the 1997 animated film on **November 21, 1997**, she would have been **96 years old**—about **96 years and 5 months**. She was born on **June 18, 1901**.
